item.title: Do You Have Unrealistic Expectations Of Others?
item.description: Unrealistic expectations can quietly sabotage relationships by blinding us to red flags and clear warnings. When we idealize others or ignore what they openly tell us about themselves, we set ourselves up for disappointment. True empathy includes accepting reality, honoring limitations, and aligning our expectations with what people can genuinely give.

item.title: How Can We Find And Share Our Inner Light?
item.description: Your Inner Light is the pure energy of love, truth, and consciousness within you. Though daily distractions may obscure it, stillness and self-awareness help it shine again. By nurturing gratitude, compassion, and mindful living, you strengthen this light and inspire unity, healing, and connection in others.
